trees.name: Vampire Lord
trees.description: Kill enemies with the Raze spell or power bite attack to earn perks. Each new perk requires a few more feedings.

trees.name: Werewolf
trees.description: New perks become available after feeding on enough corpses. Each new perk requires a few more feedings.

trees.name: Enchanting
trees.description: Enchanting is the art of binding magical spells to weapons and armor.

trees.name: Restoration
trees.description: The School of Restoration governs the manipulation of life energy. This skill makes it easier to cast spells like Fast Healing, Turn Undead, and Poison Bloom.

trees.name: Illusion
trees.description: The School of Illusion governs the manipulation of the mind. This skill makes it easier to cast spells like Silence, Invisibility, and Night Eye.

trees.name: Destruction
trees.description: The School of Destruction governs the harnessing of fire, frost, shock, and other volatile energies. This skill makes it easier to cast spells like Burning Touch, Frost Rune, and Thunderbolt.

trees.name: Conjuration
trees.description: The School of Conjuration governs the reanimation of the dead and the summoning of Daedra. This skill makes it easier to cast spells like Bound Sword, Revenant, and Soul Trap.

trees.name: Alteration
trees.description: The School of Alteration governs the manipulation of the physical world. This skill makes it easier to cast spells that alter the physical traits of yourself and others.

trees.name: Speech
trees.description: Speech is the art of persuasion and bartering. Those who are skilled in Speech receive better prices from merchants and are more likely to convince others to do as they ask.

trees.name: Alchemy
trees.description: Alchemy is the art of brewing magical potions and deadly poisons.

trees.name: Sneak
trees.description: Sneaking is the art of moving unseen and unheard, and striking from the shadows. Those who are skilled in Sneak can even hide in plain sight.

trees.name: Hand to Hand
trees.description: Hand to Hand is the art of fighting with fist and claw. Those who are skilled in Hand to Hand can face armed opponents without a weapon.

trees.name: Security
trees.description: Security is the art of opening locks and picking pockets. Those who are skilled in Security can find hidden treasures, disarm an unaware target, and silently poison their foes.

trees.name: Light Armor
trees.description: The Light Armor skill governs the use of light, flexible armors like Leather, Scaled, Elven, and Glass.

trees.name: Heavy Armor
trees.description: The Heavy Armor skill governs the use of thick, protective armors like Steel, Orcish, Dwarven, Ebony, and Daedric.

trees.name: Smithing
trees.description: Smithing is the art of forging weapons and armor from raw materials.

trees.name: Block
trees.description: The Block skill governs the use of weapons and shields to defend against incoming attacks.

trees.name: Archery
trees.description: The Archery skill governs the use of bows and crossbows to attack from range.

trees.name: Two-handed
trees.description: The Two-handed skill governs the use of larger weapons such as greatswords, battleaxes, and warhammers.

trees.name: One-handed
trees.description: The One-handed skill governs the use of smaller weapons such as swords, daggers, war axes, and maces.
